panels.title: finalized TPS (included in checkpoint)
panels.description: Per-host rate(transactions_included_in_checkpoint) = finalized TPS, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (Grafana auto, ~4x the 15s scrape = ~1m).

panels.title: execution rate (executed transactions)
panels.description: Per-host rate(execution_driver_executed_transactions) = executed TPS, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (Grafana auto, ~4x the 15s scrape = ~1m).

panels.title: actual / attested CUs — p50 (1.0 = perfect)
panels.description: Per-host p50 of actual_to_attested_computation_units_ratio. 1.0 = the attestor's estimate matched actual execution; >1 the attestor under-reported, <1 over-reported. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: actual / attested CUs — p95 (1.0 = perfect)
panels.description: Per-host p95 of actual_to_attested_computation_units_ratio. 1.0 = the attestor's estimate matched actual execution; >1 the attestor under-reported, <1 over-reported. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: attested vs actual computation units (CUs, p50)
panels.description: Per-host p50 of attested_computation_units (attestor's pre-consensus estimate) vs actual_computation_units (effects' computation_cost / gas_price), both in gas units (CUs). Gap between a validator's two lines = its estimate error. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: full attestation latency p50 (wait + exec + resume)
panels.description: Total pre-consensus attestation latency: spawn_blocking pool wait + Move-VM dry-run execution.

panels.title: full attestation latency p95 (wait + exec + resume)
panels.description: Total pre-consensus attestation latency: spawn_blocking pool wait + Move-VM dry-run execution.

panels.title: full attestation latency p99 (wait + exec + resume)
panels.description: Total pre-consensus attestation latency: spawn_blocking pool wait + Move-VM dry-run execution.

panels.title: attestations / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(validator_attestations_total) = attestations completed per second on each validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: attestation task panics (per validator)
panels.description: validator_attestation_task_panics per validator (one stat tile per host). Any non-zero value (red) means an attestation dry-run task panicked on that validator - a robustness regression.

panels.title: host CPU (busy cores, whole machine)
panels.description: Host-level CPU from node-exporter: sum(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!=idle})) = busy CPU-seconds per second (= busy cores). Whole machine, NOT per-validator (all validators share the host; per-validator needs cadvisor). Use to correlate attestation/execution load with machine CPU. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: scheduled transactions per object per commit — p50
panels.description: Per-host p50 of consensus_handler_scheduled_transactions_per_object_per_commit: transactions admitted (scheduled) to a shared object in one consensus commit, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: scheduled transactions per object per commit — p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of consensus_handler_scheduled_transactions_per_object_per_commit: transactions admitted (scheduled) to a shared object in one consensus commit, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: transaction deferral rounds — p50
panels.description: Per-host p50 of consensus_handler_transaction_deferral_rounds: consensus rounds a transaction spent deferred before being scheduled or cancelled, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: transaction deferral rounds — p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of consensus_handler_transaction_deferral_rounds: consensus rounds a transaction spent deferred before being scheduled or cancelled, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: transaction deferral rounds — p99
panels.description: Per-host p99 of consensus_handler_transaction_deferral_rounds: consensus rounds a transaction spent deferred before being scheduled or cancelled, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: deferred txs / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(consensus_handler_deferred_transactions): transactions the consensus handler deferred to a later commit per second, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: congested txs / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(consensus_handler_congested_transactions): transactions deferred specifically due to shared-object congestion per second, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: cancelled txs / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(consensus_handler_cancelled_transactions): transactions cancelled by the consensus handler (e.g. deferred past the limit) per second, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: max scheduled object cost per commit — regular
panels.description: Per-host max accumulated scheduled (estimated) per-object execution cost in a regular consensus commit (consensus_handler_max_congestion_control_object_costs, commit_type=regular_commit), one curve per validator. Compare against the per-commit limit to see scheduled-vs-limit overshoot.

panels.title: max scheduled object cost per commit — randomness
panels.description: Per-host max accumulated scheduled (estimated) per-object execution cost in a randomness consensus commit (consensus_handler_max_congestion_control_object_costs, commit_type=randomness_commit), one curve per validator. Compare against the per-commit limit to see scheduled-vs-limit overshoot.

panels.title: receipt → executed — p50
panels.description: Per-host p50 of validator_transaction_execution_latency: validator-internal latency from receiving a transaction (submit_tx) until it finished executing - spans pre-consensus check, consensus, post-consensus validation, sequencing (incl. deferral), and execution. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: receipt → executed — p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of validator_transaction_execution_latency: validator-internal latency from receiving a transaction (submit_tx) until it finished executing - spans pre-consensus check, consensus, post-consensus validation, sequencing (incl. deferral), and execution. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: receipt → executed — p99
panels.description: Per-host p99 of validator_transaction_execution_latency: validator-internal latency from receiving a transaction (submit_tx) until it finished executing - spans pre-consensus check, consensus, post-consensus validation, sequencing (incl. deferral), and execution. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: post-consensus validation latency — p50
panels.description: Per-host p50 of post_consensus_validation_latency: time for validate_and_resolve_conflicts over one commit's user transactions (Checks #0-#3 plus owned-object conflict resolution). One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: post-consensus validation latency — p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of post_consensus_validation_latency: time for validate_and_resolve_conflicts over one commit's user transactions (Checks #0-#3 plus owned-object conflict resolution). One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: internal execution latency p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of authority_state_internal_execution_latency: the pure VM execution time of a certificate (the execution step alone, not the whole receipt->executed pipeline). One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: validation dropped txs / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(consensus_handler_validation_dropped_transactions): UserTransactionV1/V2 dropped by post-consensus validation (Checks #0-#3, e.g. attestation verification, dedup, conflicts) per second, one curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: settlement finality latency (client, via fullnode)
panels.description: Client-side end-to-end: submit -> certified finalized effects (NOT checkpoint inclusion), measured by the TransactionDriver on the fullnode; includes network + fullnode time. Fullnodes only, real transactions (ping=false). Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: submit transaction latency (client, via fullnode)
panels.description: Client-side: time from start of submission until a validator accepts the transaction (includes retries), measured by the TransactionDriver on the fullnode. Not finality. Fullnodes only, real transactions (ping=false). Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: checkpoint creation lag — p50
panels.description: Per-host p50 of checkpoint_creation_latency: time from the consensus commit timestamp to when this validator builds (creates) the checkpoint. Grows with execution backlog — shared-object transactions execute in consensus-assigned order (serialized per object), so under contention the builder waits on that sequential execution before it can seal the checkpoint. One curve per validator. NOTE: values are in SECONDS (the metric help text says ms, but it records as_secs_f64). Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: checkpoint creation lag — p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of checkpoint_creation_latency: time from the consensus commit timestamp to when this validator builds (creates) the checkpoint. Grows with execution backlog — shared-object transactions execute in consensus-assigned order (serialized per object), so under contention the builder waits on that sequential execution before it can seal the checkpoint. One curve per validator. NOTE: values are in SECONDS (the metric help text says ms, but it records as_secs_f64). Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: checkpoint creation lag — p99
panels.description: Per-host p99 of checkpoint_creation_latency: time from the consensus commit timestamp to when this validator builds (creates) the checkpoint. Grows with execution backlog — shared-object transactions execute in consensus-assigned order (serialized per object), so under contention the builder waits on that sequential execution before it can seal the checkpoint. One curve per validator. NOTE: values are in SECONDS (the metric help text says ms, but it records as_secs_f64). Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: execution dispatch queue
panels.description: Per-host execution_driver_dispatch_queue: transactions that are ready to execute and queued at the execution driver, waiting for a worker to pick them up. Grows when execution can't keep up with admitted work (backpressure). One curve per validator.

panels.title: pending transactions (waiting for inputs)
panels.description: Per-host transaction_manager_num_pending_certificates: transactions in the transaction manager waiting for their input objects to become available (not yet ready to execute). Not draining is a stall/overload signal. One curve per validator.

panels.title: execution queueing delay p95
panels.description: Per-host p95 of execution_queueing_delay_s: delay between a transaction becoming ready and actually starting execution (sampled). Grows when execution workers are saturated. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: post-consensus load-shed drops / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(consensus_handler_load_shedding_dropped_transactions): user transactions dropped AFTER consensus by the stake-weighted quorum load-shedding percentage (PR #11301). Heavy execution → overload → drops. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: post-consensus load-shed % — quorum
panels.description: Per-host consensus_handler_load_shedding_percentage: the enforced stake-weighted quorum (2f+1) shed % applied to user transactions in the most recent commit (0 when P-COOL is off). This is the rate actually acted on. One curve per validator.

panels.title: post-consensus load-shed % — local
panels.description: Per-host authority_load_shedding_percentage: this validator's locally computed shed % (the value broadcast to peers), not necessarily what is enforced. One curve per validator.

panels.title: consensus-queue load shedding %
panels.description: Per-host consensus_queue_load_shedding_percentage: a SEPARATE admission-control signal based on consensus-queue length (not an input to authority_load_shedding_percentage). One curve per validator.

panels.title: pre-consensus overload rejections / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(validator_service_num_rejected_tx_during_overload), summed across error_type: user transactions rejected BEFORE consensus by check_system_overload on the submit path (validator_v2). Fires even when the post-consensus percentages are 0. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: split-brain checkpoint forks
panels.description: split_brain_checkpoint_forks per validator: this validator built a checkpoint that forked from the committee (split-brain). MUST stay 0 - any red is a critical safety failure.

panels.title: remote checkpoint forks
panels.description: remote_checkpoint_forks per validator: a checkpoint received from the network forked from this validator's local one. MUST stay 0 - any red is a critical safety failure.

panels.title: inconsistent state hash
panels.description: global_state_hash_inconsistent_state per validator: the live state hash disagreed with the expected/checkpointed hash. MUST stay 0 - any red is state divergence / a fork.

panels.title: double-spend attempts detected
panels.description: total_client_double_spend_attempts_detected per validator: equivocating (double-spend) client transactions detected. Nonzero is expected on adversarial workloads - the system must reject them (detection is correct behavior), not execute both.

panels.title: execution backpressure active (0/1)
panels.description: Per-host execution_cache_backpressure_status: 1 = the node is applying execution backpressure (execution lagging behind committed work). Sustained 1 (especially under W6) means execution cannot keep up with admitted load. One curve per validator.

panels.title: backpressure toggles / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(execution_cache_backpressure_toggles): how often execution backpressure engages/disengages per second. Frequent toggling means the node is repeatedly hitting the backpressure threshold. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: soft-lock rejections / sec
panels.description: Per-host rate(validator_service_num_rejected_tx_soft_lock_conflict): transactions rejected pre-consensus because of an owned-object soft-lock conflict (a competing transaction already holds the lock). Expected under owned-object contention; a sustained climb signals heavy conflict. One curve per validator. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: per-validator CPU (busy cores, cadvisor)
panels.description: Per-validator CPU from cadvisor: sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[interval])) = busy CPU-seconds per second (= busy cores) for each validator container. Container name equals the host label, so this follows the validator dropdown. Rate window: $__rate_interval (~1m).

panels.title: per-validator memory RSS (cadvisor)
panels.description: Per-validator resident memory from cadvisor: container_memory_rss for each validator container. Container name equals the host label, so this follows the validator dropdown.

panels.title: consensus overload source: graduated / sec
panels.description: Pre-consensus rejections from graduated shedding (probabilistic, soft→hard), per validator.

panels.title: consensus overload source: max-pending / sec
panels.description: Pre-consensus rejections at the max_pending_transactions capacity bound (100% graduated), per validator.

panels.title: consensus overload source: semaphore / sec
panels.description: Pre-consensus rejections from submit_semaphore exhaustion (concurrency limit), per validator.

panels.title: attestation dry-run execution p50
panels.description: Move-VM dry-run execution only (spawn_blocking closure body), excluding pool wait.

panels.title: attestation dry-run execution p95
panels.description: Move-VM dry-run execution only (spawn_blocking closure body), excluding pool wait.

panels.title: attestation dry-run execution p99
panels.description: Move-VM dry-run execution only (spawn_blocking closure body), excluding pool wait.

panels.title: attestation pool wait p50 (spawn_blocking)
panels.description: Time an attestation dry-run waits on the spawn_blocking pool before a worker starts it (queue wait only).

panels.title: attestation pool wait p95 (spawn_blocking)
panels.description: Time an attestation dry-run waits on the spawn_blocking pool before a worker starts it (queue wait only).

panels.title: attestation pool wait p99 (spawn_blocking)
panels.description: Time an attestation dry-run waits on the spawn_blocking pool before a worker starts it (queue wait only).

panels.title: attestation async resume p50 (runtime reschedule)
panels.description: Time from the dry-run finishing on the blocking pool until the awaiting async task resumes (join return trip); grows when the async runtime is saturated.

panels.title: attestation async resume p95 (runtime reschedule)
panels.description: Time from the dry-run finishing on the blocking pool until the awaiting async task resumes (join return trip); grows when the async runtime is saturated.

panels.title: attestation async resume p99 (runtime reschedule)
panels.description: Time from the dry-run finishing on the blocking pool until the awaiting async task resumes (join return trip); grows when the async runtime is saturated.

panels.title: consensus in-flight transactions (num_inflight → max_pending)
panels.description: Consensus in-flight transactions per validator: sum of sequencing_certificate_inflight over tx types, which mirrors the internal num_inflight_transactions counter (incremented when a tx is submitted to consensus, decremented once it is sequenced or dropped). This is the value the graduated / max_pending load shedding compares against max_pending_transactions (default 20000, per validator); shedding ramps up as it approaches that limit.
